## CredentialService.processRequest() method

Process a received [RequestCredentialMessage](./core.requestcredentialmessage.md)<!-- -->. This will not accept the credential request or send a credential. It will only update the existing credential record with the information from the credential request message. Use  after calling this method to create a credential.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
processRequest(messageContext: InboundMessageContext<RequestCredentialMessage>): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```
